biggest_catch: Very slow earn rate: at 280 points/week cap it takes roughly 35+ weeks of consistent activity to reach a single $10 payout — this is a patience play, and you hand over health data to researchers.
catches: 10,000 points = $10, but weekly earning caps (~280 points/week reported) mean one payout takes many months.
Passive health-data sharing is the product: wearable and activity data is shared (anonymized/aggregated) with researchers — privacy tradeoff.
US only and 18+ per app-store listing; international users are excluded.
Points expire and activity is capped; not all tracked actions earn points.
Redemption options: PayPal, direct deposit, gift cards, or charity donation.
